description: Round-3A convergence top-up. Raises every previously sampled (variant, domain, subject) cell from n=3 to n=14, the project's own convergence threshold k*=14 established in data/canonical/moe_routing_v1/convergence.json (bootstrap 500, L1 tolerance 0.05). Before this round only 1 of 11 cells met k*. Already-registered files are skipped by the downloader.
